title: REA: From Correct LLM Judgments to Safe Decision Delivery
abstract: arXiv:2610.17473v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative safety guards must classify requests correctly and return outputs that applications can parse. Reasoning guards can improve classification accuracy while producing outputs that applications cannot parse. When applications cannot extract a correct prediction, fallback handling can allow harmful requests or block safe ones. We introduce Resolve--Express--Act (REA), a framework that traces judgments through parsing and fallback to application actions. Experiments on classifiers and safety guards show that correct predictions can appear in incorrectly formatted outputs. Parsing the safety verdict preserves the reasoning guard's accuracy advantage, while stricter explanation requirements reject additional correct predictions. Accepting formatting variations recovers most rejected correct predictions. Held-out tests confirm that output requirements and generation limits affect whether correct predictions can be parsed. translated_title: REA：从正确的LLM判断到安全的决策交付
translated_abstract: 生成式安全防护系统必须正确分类请求，并返回应用程序可以解析的输出。推理型防护系统可以提高分类准确性，但其产生的输出应用程序却无法解析。当应用程序无法提取出正确的预测时，后备处理机制可能会放行有害请求或阻断安全请求。我们提出了“解析—表达—行动”（Resolve--Express--Act，REA）框架，用于追踪判断从解析和后备处理到应用程序动作的全过程。在分类器和安全防护系统上的实验表明，正确的预测可能出现在格式错误的输出中。对安全判定结果进行解析可以保留推理型防护系统的准确性优势，而更严格的解释要求会拒绝更多正确的预测。接受格式上的变化可以挽回大部分被拒绝的正确预测。保留测试证实，输出要求和生成限制会影响正确预测能否被解析。在我们的故障开放……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出REA（解析—表达—行动）框架，追踪LLM安全判断从输出解析、后备处理到应用动作的全过程，发现正确的预测可能因输出格式问题而丢失，并证明通过解析安全判定并接受格式变化，可以在保留推理型防护准确性优势的同时挽回大部分被错误拒绝的正确预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the REA (Resolve--Express--Act) framework that traces LLM safety judgments through parsing and fallback to application actions, showing that correct predictions can be lost due to output formatting issues, and that parsing safety verdicts while accepting formatting variations preserves reasoning guards' accuracy advantage and recovers most rejected correct predictions.
